evidence.quote: Dalston Superstore is East London’s queer nightlife institution.
Functioning in equal parts as a debaucherous nightclub, bar, cafe, community space and gallery
Superstore is as much a music-forward club as it is a front-running drag and performance space.
We’ve played host to dance music heavy-hitters
Drag Brunch at Dalston Superstore with Femmi & Fabio!

findings.value: Two DJs on club nights, one upstairs and one in the basement club room, which opens Friday and Saturday. Drag brunch on weekend afternoons, Sunday karaoke, weekly M.A.D Wednesdays, film screenings and open decks.

evidence.quote: On club nights we have 2 DJs playing, one in the upstairs space, and one in the downstairs club space

dishing up a smorgasbord of bacon, bubbles, and fake boobs every Saturday and Sunday from 12-4pm.
We recently created M.A.D (Mutual Aid Distribution) Wednesdays: a weekly party
